title: Audit Inspector: deterministic export jobs, saved scopes, and retention-aware filters
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build deterministic, auditable export jobs for the Console Audit Inspector. Users must be able to save a scope (filters + time window + column projection), run a queued export (CSV/JSON), and get a signed export manifest that records the exact query plan (including applied redaction and retention rules) for replayability and compliance.
acceptance_criteria: Console: 'Save scope' persists filters, columns, and pagination settings to a saved-query object visible in the user's library
API: a POST /audit/exports endpoint accepts either ad-hoc queries or a saved scope id and returns an export job id
Export jobs produce a signed export_manifest.json that includes the deterministic query hash, retention policy version, redaction spec, and generation timestamp
Exports can be requested as CSV or NDJSON and streamed for large datasets with resumable cursors
RBAC v2 enforced: export job respects role-based redaction rules and only includes fields permitted to the requester's role
Saved scopes honor org-level retention overrides and annotate export manifests when data is truncated by retention
Admins can view export audit trail (who exported what, saved scopes used, manifest hash) in the built-in audit viewer
Unit and integration tests covering exporter determinism, RBAC filters, and manifest schema
tasks: Design: saved-scope UX flow and naming/ownership model (personal vs org-shared)
Backend: deterministic query serializer and canonicalizer for stable hashing
Backend: export job service with idempotency key and resumable cursor support
Security: integrate redaction pipeline with RBAC v2 rules and KMS for handling sensitive fields
Console: export job status UI with link to signed manifest and download URL
Docs: Confluence page for export manifest schema and compliance guidance
QA: stress test for concurrent exports and large resultsets (>50M rows)
comments: 2025-02-18 — Aisha Patel: Kickoff meeting notes uploaded. Decided to make saved scopes first-class objects owned by teams; personal scopes default to private.

2025-02-21 — Marco Reyes: Prototype of deterministic canonicalizer ready. It canonicalizes filter order, normalizes timezone to UTC, and strips non-semantic whitespace. Hash collisions extremely unlikely under current algorithm (sha256 of canonical JSON).

2025-02-25 — Priya Nair (Security): Reviewed redaction integration. Agreed we must store redaction version in export_manifest and surface a 'redaction_applied' flag per row for forensic purposes. Raised concern about storing manifests longer than retention window; resolved to keep manifests beyond data retention but mark truncated exports.
2025-02-28 — UX Review (Jules): Mockups for saved-scope library and export modal posted. Suggest adding naming convention guidance and 'share with team' toggle.
2025-03-01 — Marco Reyes: Backend export service accepts saved_scope_id and returns job id. Implemented resumable cursor token tied to job id. Started integration tests for RBAC enforcement.
2025-03-03 — QA (Lina): Found edge case where exported CSV mis-encodes non-BMP characters in older Go CSV library. Filed bug ENG-82600 and added test vector.
2025-03-03 — Aisha Patel: Marking security_review_required=true. Need final sign-off from Compliance before GA.
notes: Primary goal is compliance-friendly exports: deterministic manifests enable reproducible forensic investigations and allow us to verify exports against saved-query snapshots and RBAC state at time of export.
